replacements.Ninguna tecnología cubre todo bien. La r: No technology covers everything well. The real answer combines four layers, each doing what it does best.
replacements.Bloquear automáticamente si el importe s: Automatically block if the amount exceeds 3× the user's average in that merchant category, or if the transaction comes from a new location with a high amount.
replacements.Instantáneo, sin coste por transacción,: Instant, with no per-transaction model cost, and auditable. For stable, known patterns it is more reliable and cheaper than any model.
replacements.Los fraudadores aprenden a mantenerse po: Fraudsters learn to stay below the threshold. When patterns evolve, the rules become obsolete and nobody can keep them up to date.
replacements.ML clásico — núcleo operativo a escala: Classical ML — operational core at scale
replacements.Puntúa cada transacción de 0 a 100 en ri: Scores every transaction from 0 to 100 for fraud risk, trained on thousands of labelled transactions (fraud / not fraud). It captures complex combinations of signals that rules cannot enumerate.
replacements.Métricas claras y automatizables (AUC-RO: Clear, automatable metrics (AUC-ROC, precision, recall). It scales to millions of daily transactions. The result is reproducible and explainable with SHAP.
replacements.Necesita reentrenarse periódicamente cua: It needs periodic retraining when fraud patterns evolve. Without drift monitoring, performance degrades silently.
replacements.LLM + RAG — explicación al analista: LLM + RAG — explanation for the analyst
replacements.Cuando el modelo de ML puntúa alto una t: When the ML model scores a transaction highly and an alert is created, the analyst asks: "why did this alert fire?" The system searches internal procedure manuals and regulations and returns a contextualized explanation.
replacements.Por qué no es el núcleo: Why it is not the core
replacements.El coste y la latencia son prohibitivos: Cost and latency are prohibitive for millions of daily transactions. It does not replace the ML classifier; it complements it for the human-review layer.
replacements.Documentación interna que cambia frecuen: Internal documentation that changes frequently, knowledge bases of fraud typologies, explanation of alerts to compliance teams.
replacements.Para casos de alto riesgo que superan el: For high-risk cases above the ML threshold: it consults the customer's complete history, cross-checks known-fraud-pattern databases, verifies external data, and drafts a traceable decision report.
replacements.Análisis profundo de casos donde la cant: Deep analysis of cases where the amount at risk justifies the process cost. Not for the massive transaction volume; for reviewing the most complex cases.
replacements.Cada paso puede fallar y los fallos en c: Every step can fail and chained failures are difficult to detect. The reasoning chain needs human supervision before final decisions are made.
replacements.La respuesta real combina las cuatro cap: The real answer combines all four layers: rules for instant filters, classical ML to score the full volume, LLM+RAG to explain alerts to the analyst, and an agent to investigate the most complex high-risk cases.
